title: Composition calculation at one outgoing-arrow factor
statement: Let $I$ be a preordered set, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ [def-pc-scheme], and $F_i$ abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on the small etale sites of $D_i$. Put $J_l=\mathrm{Injective.under}(F_l)$ and $P_i=\prod_{h:i\to l}(D(h^{op}))_*J_l$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-coefficient-injective-target], with projection $p_{i,h}$. For $f:i\to j$ and $h:j\to l$ define $a_{f,h}$ as the inverse transpose along $D(f^{op})$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] of $p_{i,f\gg h}$ followed by $\mathrm{lowerStarComp}(D(h^{op}),D(f^{op}),D((f\gg h)^{op}),D.map\_comp)^{-1}_{J_l}$. All comparisons have the explicit transports supplied by $D.map\_comp$. For every $f:i\to j$, $g:j\to k$ and outgoing $h:k\to l$, let $q_f=\mathrm{Pi.lift}(a_{f,s})_{s:j\to m}$. Then $a_{f\gg g,h}=\mathrm{upperStarComp}(D(g^{op}),D(f^{op}),D((f\gg g)^{op}),D.map\_comp)_{P_i}\gg (D(g^{op}))^*(q_f)\gg a_{g,h}$. This is an equality of morphisms to the single factor $(D(h^{op}))_*J_l$, and does not assert any identity law.

proof.text: Apply the generic comparison transpose equation, proved by applying the injective adjunction homEquiv and using its unit formula together with upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app. For the composite adjunction, homEquiv_naturality_left removes the inverse-image map of the intermediate product transition; homEquiv_naturality_right then moves the final direct-image comparison. Pi.lift_π gives the intermediate projection equation. Evaluate lowerStarComp_assoc′ at Injective.under(F_l), and invert its commutative square by cancellation of the component isomorphisms. The resulting inverse comparison equation identifies the direct transpose with the double transpose. Transport the outgoing-arrow index using Category.assoc, compose with the initial product projection, and apply congrArg to the inverse homEquiv. This proves one component, without product extensionality.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_coefficient_product_composition_component
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k) (t : Σ l : I, k ⟶ l) :
    ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map (f ≫ g).op)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (Pi.π (fun t : Σ l : I, i ⟶ l ↦
          (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map t.2.op)).obj
            (Injective.under (F t.1))) ⟨t.1, (f ≫ g) ≫ t.2⟩ ≫
        (lowerStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map t.2.op) (D.map (f ≫ g).op)
          (D.map ((f ≫ g) ≫ t.2).op) (D.map_comp t.2.op (f ≫ g).op)).inv.app
            (Injective.under (F t.1))) =
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
        (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app
          (etaleCoefficientInjectiveTarget D F i) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map
        (Pi.lift fun s : Σ l : I, j ⟶ l ↦
          ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (Pi.π (fun t : Σ l : I, i ⟶ l ↦
          (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map t.2.op)).obj
            (Injective.under (F t.1))) ⟨s.1, f ≫ s.2⟩ ≫
        (lowerStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map s.2.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ s.2).op) (D.map_comp s.2.op f.op)).inv.app
            (Injective.under (F s.1)))) ≫
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (Pi.π (fun t : Σ l : I, j ⟶ l ↦
          (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map t.2.op)).obj
            (Injective.under (F t.1))) ⟨t.1, g ≫ t.2⟩ ≫
        (lowerStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map t.2.op) (D.map g.op)
          (D.map (g ≫ t.2).op) (D.map_comp t.2.op g.op)).inv.app
            (Injective.under (F t.1)))
